title: poa nemoralis var. rhenana
intro: Poa nemoralis var. rhenana, commonly known as Rhenish meadow-grass, is a variety of grass found in European meadows. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which may include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa nemoralis var. rhenana are thought to be attributed to its calming and soothing effects, which may be useful in treating anxiety and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of benefits and actions.
